candidates.result: Source admission only; all other source-label contexts remain separately audited.
candidates.scope: Untreated Phase II, 21% oxygen, two 18-year-old adult-origin fibroblast donors; 22 RNA records, 21 with source-reported respiratory spare capacity.

candidates.finding: No reusable per-RNA matrix or exact culture-to-NCC crosswalk acquired in this bounded review. NCC remains a specifically named compartmentalization reporter. The methods reference mm10 despite a human-cell experimental description; source clarification would be required rather than silently correcting it.
candidates.review_extent: Primary article XML and directly linked deposit search; supplementary-file request timed out and publisher PDF request returned 403.

candidates.finding: Human RNA and cellular phenotypes are distinct from worm healthspan/lifespan outcomes. A paired human functional-readout/culture mapping was not admitted by this screen.
candidates.review_extent: Primary article and 24-sample GEO series inspected; detailed source-table acquisition stopped after the Sturm subset qualified.

candidates.finding: The screened reprogramming data are murine; the source species is Mus musculus, outside the human adult-primary comparator question.
